One continuous take, a single unbroken camera move like a chase drone following the action, no cuts, photoreal action-comedy, realistic physics, 9:16. The camera never passes through walls, glass or buildings. @Image1 is the exact first frame. @Image2 is the man: enormous waxed handlebar moustache with spiral tips that always covers his mouth, black turtleneck, charcoal blazer. @Image3 is the woman: platinum buzz cut, round red-tinted spectacles, ivory double-breasted suit, red scarf, one silver stopwatch on her lapel. @Image4 is the gold AURUM can.
[0-2 s] Bank alarm bells ringing. On the bank rooftop the man gives the lens a deadpan look, clutches the duffel bag, and does a BASE jump off the roof edge; his gold parachute snaps open instantly with a loud whump.
[2-6 s] The camera follows him as he glides calmly down under the gold canopy above the city street. Below, a gold vintage convertible driven by the woman swerves hard through traffic, tyres screeching, two police cars with sirens wailing close behind.
[6-9 s] He steers the parachute and lands perfectly in the passenger seat of the moving convertible; he releases the canopy and it flies back and drapes over the windshield of the first police car, which brakes harmlessly.
[9-13 s] The second police car pulls alongside. Deadpan, he takes a gold AURUM can from the bag, shakes it, aims it like a pistol and cracks it open: a huge jet of golden soda foam blasts across the police windshield with a loud fizzing whoosh; the police car slides to a gentle harmless stop behind them.
[13-15 s] The woman clicks her silver stopwatch once with a dry half-smile; the bag on his lap falls open: it is full of gold AURUM cans, not money. The convertible speeds off down the golden avenue.
Comedic, stylish, nobody is hurt. Sound: realistic synchronized sound only — alarm bells, parachute whump, wind, sirens, screeching tyres, engine roar, can crack, foam blast, stopwatch click. No music, no speech. No text, no logos besides AURUM.
